cases.text: How much have I spent on bubble tea related purchases this year?
cases.actualText: Related purchases need explicit inclusion rules before a calculation. Which purchase-description terms or categories should count? I can propose literal rules for your review and approval. Your original request: “How much have I spent on bubble tea related purchases this year?”

cases.text: How much did I spend on Food & Drinks and Entertainment this month?
Am I doing well with my money?
cases.actualText: What would you like to assess: recorded spending against a category budget, a change from a previous period, or a particular category? Please name the category and period you want. An expense ledger alone cannot establish your overall financial health. Your original request: “Am I doing well with my money?”

cases.text: What did I spend this month, and what percentage of it was Food & Drinks?
cases.actualText: I cannot combine a spending total with a separate category-percentage answer. Would you like the recorded total or a complete category breakdown? Keep the original subject, dates and other filters in your next question. Your original request: “What did I spend this month, and what percentage of it was Food & Drinks?”

cases.text: Did I spend more on Food & Drinks or Bubble Tea this month?
cases.actualText: Please resubmit the full question with one category. Combining multiple categories is not supported.
